title: Equivalences of sheaf categories identifying the embedded-image direct images
statement: Let X,Z be topological spaces in universe u, i:Z→X a continuous embedding, Y a topological space in universe u+1, and e:Y≃ₜX a homeomorphism. Let D=e⁻¹(range i), and let j:D→Y be the inclusion. There exist equivalences T:Sh(X,Type(u+1))≌Sh(Y,Type(u+1)) and S:Sh(Z,Type(u+1))≌Sh(D,Type(u+1)), a natural isomorphism Γ(X,−)≅T⋙Γ(Y,−), and a natural isomorphism i_*⋙T≅S⋙j_*. These are direct-image statements, with no inverse-image or adjunction unit assumed.

source.place: Tag 09ZG, application to the closed-image transport of the assigned node; Mathlib Topology.Sets.Opens Homeomorph.opensCongr, CategoryTheory.Sites.Equivalence Equivalence.sheafCongr

proof.text: For any homeomorphism between arbitrary universes, its equivalence on opens is a dense subsite. Prove preservation and reflection of covering sieves pointwise: forward, factor an arrow of the image sieve and pull membership back by the inverse homeomorphism; reverse, send a covering arrow to its image. Equivalence supplies cover density and local full faithfulness.

Set h:D≃ₜZ to e restricted to D, followed by the inverse of the embedding's homeomorphism to its range. Use sheafCongr on the equivalences of opens from e.symm and h.symm, with the dense-subsite proof, to obtain T and S.

At the top open the inverse open-set functor preserves top, giving the global-sections isomorphism by mapIso of eqToIso. Its naturality is the underlying sheaf morphism's naturality. The two direct-image composites are definitionally equal: h.symm(z) has underlying point e.symm(i(z)). Use Iso.refl under ObjectProperty.isoMk and NatIso.ofComponents.

theorem embedding_pushforward_transport
    {X Z : TopCat.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (hi : Topology.IsEmbedding i)
    (Y : TopCat.{u + 1}) (e : Y ≃ₜ X) :
    let D : Set Y := e ⁻¹' Set.range i
    let j : TopCat.of D ⟶ Y := TopCat.ofHom ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
    ∃ (T : X.Sheaf (Type (u + 1)) ≌ Y.Sheaf (Type (u + 1)))
      (S : Z.Sheaf (Type (u + 1)) ≌ (TopCat.of D).Sheaf (Type (u + 1))),
      Nonempty
        (sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Type (u + 1)) ⋙
            (evaluation (Opens X)ᵒᵖ (Type (u + 1))).obj (op ⊤) ≅
          T.functor ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) (Type (u + 1)) ⋙
            (evaluation (Opens Y)ᵒᵖ (Type (u + 1))).obj (op ⊤)) ∧
      Nonempty
        ((Opens.map i).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) ⋙ T.functor ≅
          S.functor ⋙ Sheaf.pushforward (Type (u + 1)) j)
